description.value:
The shield is not raised, because it was never lowered. It occupies no hand, demands no attention, turns aside what it can and endures what it cannot, and on the rare occasion something manages to shatter it, it is whole again before you have finished being surprised.

1st Level

  • Gain the Aegis: a +3 circumstance bonus to AC, permanently active.
  • It takes no hands and functions even with weapons in both hands.
  • Hardness 5 + 2 per level above 1st. HP 30 + 10 per level above 1st, with a Broken Threshold of half.
  • It cannot be sundered, disarmed, or left behind, and reforms at full Hit Points at the start of your turn if destroyed.

5th Level

  • Once per turn, you may Shield Block without spending a reaction.

10th Level

  • The Aegis gains Regeneration equal to your level.

15th Level

  • The Aegis covers you from every direction. You cannot be flanked, and you gain its bonus against attacks from any source.
  • When you Shield Block, the attacker takes damage equal to the amount the Aegis absorbed.

In Foundry: the +3 circumstance bonus is on your AC at all times and The Aegis is in your inventory with hardness and Hit Points that follow your level. Shield Block from PF2e's damage-card button; a destroyed Aegis reforms at the start of your turn, and from 10th it regenerates then too. From 15th you cannot be flanked.

For the table: blocking once per turn without a reaction from 5th, and the reflected damage from 15th.
